The changes made were:
- Phase 1: 5 dead Logger imports removed
- Phase 2: /test-notification route removed from server.js
- Phase 3: ~40 debug traces removed
- Phase 4: ~12 redundant info+success pairs merged
- Phase 5: 6 log levels corrected
- Phase 6: 34 info→debug conversions on read-only endpoints


- Now I'm updating the existing2026-07-20 section to append these changes.
